decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons:
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 22nd February 2006, the erection of a rear roof extension, measuring 4.0m deep, 2.35m high, and 4.0m wide on the rear roof projection, as shown on drawings 2006-010-001 Rev E, received 13th April 2006, giving a total volume increase of 37.6 cubic metres, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed dimensions of the roof extension and resulting volume is acceptable within the constraints of the relevant classes of the order.
Informative:
This development is only lawful while the property is operating as a single family dwelling house. Planning permission will be required if at any time this house is converted into more than one self contained unit.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension.
